children: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approved five energy projects and facilities on Thursday in its effort to clear the way for critical natural gas infrastructure projects.
The approved projects include Sabine Pass's authority to operate three additional liquefaction trains at an existing terminal in Cameron Parish, La.
The commission has also issued Mountain Valley Pipeline a certificate to operate a project in Virginia and West Virginia to add 600,000 dekatherms per day of firm transportation capacity.

The approvals include a southeast Virginia energy storage project, a building certificate for the Forza Pipeline in New Mexico and Texas, and then an expansion of Texas Eastern's projects in Mississippi.
